title: Generate a 4096-bit RSA SSH key
summary: Create a strong RSA SSH key with a comment (like your email) for identification. This is a common format for older systems.

steps.explain: Generate a 4096-bit RSA key with a comment (e.g., your email) for identification.

placeholders.name: COMMENT
placeholders.description: A comment to identify the key, usually your email address.

steps.expect: The tool prompts for a file path and passphrase, then confirms the key was saved.
